custodyProfile.uncertainty: The Ethereum token's immediate reserve is native KAG held by KMS Labs in segregated wallets. Section 8(e) denies ERC-20 holders legal, equitable or beneficial title to these reserves and disclaims any trust or fiduciary relationship; bankruptcy remoteness and a rehypothecation prohibition are not established. ABX, Brinks and Loomis are downstream physical-bullion custody providers for native KAG; provider shares and the KMS Labs reserve-wallet addresses are undisclosed.
